If integration succeeds but activity persistence fails, report that partial failure clearly; never claim tracking succeeded.\\n\\n## Acceptance criteria\\n\\n- Integrating a card worktree with one or several outgoing commits creates and records exactly one squash commit under the card's stable `internalId`.\\n- The squash commit contains the combined change between the project branch and the rebased card branch. Primary checkpoint and activity-file commits are not included.\\n- The squash commit appears once under `Integrate into project` in the existing card commit selector and opens one combined diff for the integration.\\n- Integration with no outgoing commits or no combined change remains rejected and creates no activity record.\\n- Failed integration creates no activity record. History-persistence failure after a successful squash commit is visible.\\n- Project-level worktree integration creates no card activity.\\n- Tests cover one and several source commits producing one squash commit, rebase before integration, stable card ownership, squash cleanup and persistence failure paths, and project-level exclusion.\\n\\r\\n\\n===== design\\\\releases\\\\0_0_4\\\\F_96_ctrl_enter_on_action_input.md =====\\r\\n---\\nauthor: \\nid: F_96\\ninternalId: d33002d3-ee0e-4c08-8e26-36f790500ee2\\ntitle: ctrl enter on action input\\nstatus: ready\\nowner: \\naffects:\\nagents:\\npolicy:\\nafter: d4afff38-5581-42f4-a8f3-8ded807ab27a\\n---\\n\\nwhen pressing ctrl + enter on action input, the input is sent, this is good, but before this happens, the input box still adds an enter, which should not be the case.\\n\\n# Current state\\n\\n`ActionAgentPrompt` handles `Ctrl+Enter` and `Meta+Enter` on the prompt wrapper during event bubbling. MDXEditor handles `Enter` first, inserts a newline, then the wrapper flushes and sends the changed prompt.\\n\\n# Implementation details\\n\\n- Intercept `Ctrl+Enter` and `Meta+Enter` during capture, before MDXEditor handles the key.\\n- Prevent default behavior and stop propagation, then flush the latest prompt before running the existing shortcut callback.\\n- Keep plain `Enter`, `Shift+Enter`, and disabled shortcut behavior unchanged.\\n- Extend `action_agent_prompt.test.tsx` with regression coverage proving the editor does not receive the send shortcut.\\n\\n# Acceptance criteria\\n\\n- `Ctrl+Enter` sends current prompt without inserting a newline.\\n- `Meta+Enter` has same behavior.\\n- Prompt is flushed before send callback runs.\\n- Plain `Enter` and `Shift+Enter` still insert newlines.\\n\\r\\n\",\n.\\design\\activity\\project.json:364: \"status\": \"waitingForInput\",\n.\\design\\activity\\project.json:864: \"content\": \"\\n===== B_83_delete_card_reloads_project.md =====\\r\\n---\\nauthor: \\nid: B_83\\ninternalId: 0b35236a-2fe4-4b58-86f8-bd84af5ac7ce\\ntitle: delete card reloads project\\nstatus: ready\\nowner: \\naffects:\\nagents:\\n - design/activity/card__0b35236a-2fe4-4b58-86f8-bd84af5ac7ce.json#conversation=agent-d3dee85b-e4fb-4763-89bc-755010c3286e\\n - design/activity/card__0b35236a-2fe4-4b58-86f8-bd84af5ac7ce.json#conversation=agent-eddffaed-b7c2-49fc-ac0d-64d88b763b83\\npolicy:\\nafter: \\n---\\n\\ndeleting a card currently reloads the entire project (project\\\\_loading.ts: reloadCurrentProjectSnapshot). this shouldn't be done.\\n\\n## Current state\\n\\n`CardOperations.deleteCard` delegates to `ProjectFileOperations.deleteProjectFile`. Deletion flushes pending commits, repairs the following card's `after` link when needed, deletes the file, applies push mode, then calls `reloadCurrentProjectSnapshot`. That reload reads every project file and the repository index, rebuilds all cards, ensures internal IDs, and reloads agent conversations.\\n\\n## implementation details\\n\\n- After storage deletion succeeds, update `ProjectState` directly: merge the committed ordering-repair file, remove the deleted path from loaded files and `repositoryFiles`, and rebuild the snapshot once.\\n- Dispatch existing data-service change and card events so board, file tree, open documents, and selection react normally.\\n- Remove `reloadCurrentProjectSnapshot` from the shared file-deletion path; keep full reloads for operations that cannot derive their local result.\\n- Preserve pending-commit flushing, ordering repair, SHA use, auto/manual push behavior, and unchanged local state when deletion fails.\\n- Update `card_operations` regression tests to prove deletion performs no full project or repository-index reload.\\n\\n## acceptance criteria\\n\\n- Deleting a card removes it from the board, file tree, loaded files, and repository index without calling `reloadCurrentProjectSnapshot`, `loadProject`, or `listRepositoryFiles`.\\n- A deleted middle card's follower has the correct persisted and in-memory `after` value.\\n- Existing card removal/change events close or refresh affected views without reloading agent conversations.\\n- Failed deletion leaves the local snapshot unchanged; We should already have made a component for this.\\n\\n## Current state\\n\\n- `CardView` renders `CardViewScrollZones` on mobile and scrolls its card-columns container from pointer movement at either edge.\\n- Each transparent zone is only 3 px wide. This is too narrow for reliable touch input, while card surfaces suppress native scrolling for drag-and-drop.\\n- Existing tests invoke the zones directly and therefore do not expose the unusable touch target.\\n\\n## implementation details\\n\\n- Keep `CardViewScrollZones`; widen both zones to the 20 px mobile card-view gutters using one named constant.\\n- Keep zones above card drag surfaces and preserve existing pointer capture, scroll direction, cancellation, native scroll boundaries, card dragging, and desktop behavior.\\n- Verify the regression on a mobile viewport. Keep existing interaction tests; do not add a test tied only to the visual width constant.\\n\\n## acceptance criteria\\n\\n- On mobile, dragging vertically from either outer card-view gutter reliably scrolls the card columns when cards fill the viewport.\\n- Edge gestures do not drag, open, or activate cards and stop on pointer up or cancellation.\\n- Card interaction outside the edge zones and desktop card-view behavior remain unchanged.\\n\\r\\n\\n===== B_87_card_changed_not_pushed_to_mobile.md =====\\r\\n---\\nauthor: \\nid: B_87\\ninternalId: 1b39ee56-e06e-4705-840f-7541b2a57d3d\\ntitle: Card changed not pushed to mobile\\nstatus: ready\\nowner: \\naffects:\\nagents:\\n - design/activity/card__1b39ee56-e06e-4705-840f-7541b2a57d3d.json#conversation=agent-6e7b30ea-5d5c-439b-b2b0-7f656fe5a400\\n - design/activity/card__1b39ee56-e06e-4705-840f-7541b2a57d3d.json#conversation=agent-c6f98940-00b7-4041-a50e-fe0c85838b84\\npolicy:\\nafter: b692b422-3e30-4518-91c1-bcee5451b046\\n---\\n\\nWhen an agent changes a card and the app is running in electron, the app gets updates and the card refreshed. This does not happen when app is on mobile and connected to electron.\\n\\nWe should verify if every message type is correctly implemented over websockets\\n\\n## Current state\\n\\nElectron's project watcher emits card changes through `watchProject`. 21:- **Custom tokens:** roles the default MUI palette doesn't cover (column/track surfaces, the strong/hover border steps, `text-3/4`, section-header color, `primary-bg` tint, status colors) must exist in the theme under a namespace (e.g. `theme.palette.custom.*`) with light + dark values. Consume them the same way — `bgcolor: 'custom.column'`. **Never inline their hex.** If a needed token doesn't exist yet, add it to the theme, don't hardcode it in the component.
33:| Segmented-control / toolbar track, hover fill | `custom.track` |
37:| Border on hover | `custom.borderHover` |
43:| The one CTA, selection, focus, links, icon-hover | `primary.main` |
44:| Contained-button hover | `primary.dark` |
45:| Selected/tinted bg, focus ring, ID-chip bg | `custom.primaryBg` |
51:Rules: **one** `primary` per surface (the CTA/selection accent) — everything else is `text-*`/`divider`. Status colors are **decoration only** (dots, chip tints), never interactive color. Dark-mode brightness/tinting is handled inside the theme's two palettes, so a correctly-sloted component needs zero per-mode code.
70:- **Fixed heights (px):** menu row 44, ribbon 52, status bar 32, section header 40, tab row 40, standard button / control 34, dense icon button 26–28, input 42.
72:- **Radius family (px):** buttons/icon-buttons 8 (small 6–7), inputs 9, cards 10, columns/panels 12, dialogs/popups 14, chips/pills 99, color swatches 3. `borderRadius: 1` covers the 8 case; use explicit `'9px'` etc. for the others.
78:- **Rest = border, not shadow.** Resting surfaces: `border: '1px solid'`, `borderColor: 'divider'`. Inputs use `custom.borderStrong`. **Shadow only when floating or lifted** (hover, drag, dialogs/popovers).
80:- **Elevation ladder (only where floating):** card hover `0 4px 12px rgba(16,24,40,0.12)`; dragging MUI `elevation 8` + `rotate(2deg)`; contained button `0 1px 2px rgba(16,24,40,0.15)`; dialog/popup `0 24px 60px rgba(16,24,40,0.28)`; scrim `rgba(16,24,40,0.45)` + `backdropFilter: blur(2px)`.
82:- **On dark backgrounds shadows read as nothing** — the theme already handles this by making hover raise `borderColor` (`custom.borderHover`) instead of relying on shadow.
94:- `button.textTransform: 'none'` and `button.fontWeight: 600` are set in the theme — don't re-uppercase buttons.
102:- **Ghost icon button** (`IconButton`): transparent → hover `bgcolor: track` (or `background.paper` on a colored panel) + `color: primary.main`. Override MUI's default circular hover tint via `sx`.
103:- **Outlined button:** `divider` border, `text.secondary` → hover `borderColor/color: primary.main`. Destructive: hover `borderColor: error.main` + `bgcolor: custom.dangerBg`.
104:- **Contained (primary) CTA:** `primary.main` + small shadow → hover `primary.dark`.
105:- **Input/field focus:** `borderColor: primary.main` + `boxShadow: 0 0 0 3px` in `custom.primaryBg` (the soft halo). Unfocused hover: `borderColor: custom.borderHover`.
106:- **List/tree row:** hover `bgcolor: track`; selected `bgcolor: custom.primaryBg` + title `text.primary`.
107:- **Row-level actions** (delete, ⋮): hidden at rest, shown on `:hover`/`:focus-within` via **opacity** (keep in DOM so width doesn't jump).
109:- Every icon-only control gets a `Tooltip` (theme sets `arrow: true`) **and** an `aria-label`.
115:- **Buttons:** `Button variant="contained"` = the single CTA per surface; `variant="outlined"` = secondary; `variant="text"` = tertiary. Icon-only → `IconButton` in a `Tooltip`. Don't use `Link` or text `Button` where an action button belongs (that reproduces the old text-link look).
116:- **Icons:** `@mui/icons-material` **Outlined** variants; `fontSize: 18` in 34px buttons, `16` in dense, `13–15` inline. Don't hand-draw SVG.
133:4. Hover **and** focus states on every interactive element (§7); icon buttons have tooltip + `aria-label`.

Change Plan created. No edits made.

1. Block 1 — Scope model and aggregation

   - Add popup-bound `ActionUsageScopeStore` using `EventTarget`.
   - Add scoped token, completed file-change, and commit-line aggregators.
   - Deduplicate live conversation by `conversation.id`.
   - Match conversation commits only through agent history `rootConversationId`.
   - Test zero values, matching, filtering, deduplication.

2. Block 2 — Summary controls

   - Always render tokens, changes, lines.
   - Make each value button-semantic text control.
   - Any click or keyboard activation toggles one shared scope.
   - Add pointer, hover, focus styling.
   - Each tooltip defines metric, explains switching, shows both scopes, marks active scope.
   - Keep active-scope commit breakdown in lines tooltip.
   - Test pointer, keyboard, tooltips, zero, unavailable conversation.

3. Block 3 — Popup wiring and live behavior

   - Create scope store beside conversation/history stores.
   - Pass through popup bottom row into `ActionUsageSummaryOwner`.
   - Subscribe with `useSyncExternalStore`.
   - Preserve active scope across conversation selection changes.
   - Force action/card scope when no conversation displayed.
   - Test live updates, selection changes, scope preservation, unavailable reset.

4. Block 4 — Verification and completion

   - Run only affected Vitest files.
   - Run lint against changed app files and app typecheck.
   - Fix related failures.
   - Set external feature file `status: ready` only after implementation passes.

Shared-helper call sites checked: both current usage helpers serve only this summary plus focused unit tests. No other UI behavior needs compatibility mode.

Awaiting approval.
go
